body: The first-aid kit and water bottle are tied together. blue powder coats one side; a torn strip of road tape covers the other.
title: First-aid kit and water bottle, sunday after supper
gloss: Field residue and response material meet in one ambiguous personal bundle.
rival_reading: Field workers or an emergency crew could have assembled this bundle; the mixed residue and road tape do not show which came first.

body: A map and a pencil are kept together in a pocket. Three homes have been circled, but only one has been crossed off; the mark was made before the door was forced.
title: A folded address beside the raid
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
